world.topic: A third round on the workers of the positions paper-repo and internal-review-repo of the research world rw_399c28e983a7, given to you to read, starting from what the second round delivered. It kept the incumbent again because the OpenCode candidate never ran: its provider did not match the one this world has, and a refusal now shows the provider to give as it stands. Pull requests 1 and 2 in a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers hold worker.json files that `worker check` refuses. Run and judge at least one candidate that changes a worker (an OpenCode one among them) against the kept worker on held-out tasks, put the worker you keep back into the target by continuing it from its newest checkpoint, and publish the kept worker by a new pull request to a-green-hand-jack/HuTian-Workers through the github resource, with its worker.json written by `worker show` and passing `worker check`, beside its README.md. Keep it small: at most two candidates, and every world you run with at most 8 turns and 900 model seconds.
